`final class SignalReplayMethod`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayMethod.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/signal/replay/SignalReplayMethod.java)

Analysis of one method of the bytecode: frames, instructions, local variables and the expressions that define them.

## Learn more

- [How signals work](/use/in-depth/how-signals-work/)

|---|---|---|
| [`SignalReplayMethod`](/reference/signals/signalreplaymethod/) | [of](#SignalReplayMethod-factory-of)(SignalReplayClass replayClass, MethodNode method) <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span> | Analyses `method` of `replayClass`; throws the `AnalyzerException` of ASM when the bytecode is invalid. |
